description: Defines classes and functions for limiting concurrent task forks in an executor framework, including task_fork_limiter and task_fork_limiter_executor, with internal queue management and concurrency control.

classes.name: task_fork_limiter_executor
classes.description: Executor class for task_fork_limiter with specific priority, dispatching tasks to the limiter.

classes.name: task_fork_limiter
classes.description: Main class implementing task fork limiting with internal queues and concurrency control.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a task with a given priority or default priority.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task with a given priority or default priority.

methods.name: get_executors
methods.description: Returns the list of executors for different priority levels.

methods.name: handle_fork_tasks
methods.description: Handles execution of tasks in a fork, respecting batch limits.

methods.name: defer_remaining_tasks
methods.description: Dispatches remaining tasks for deferred execution.

methods.name: handle_failed_dispatch
methods.description: Handles failure to dispatch a task, reverting active fork count.

methods.name: pop_task
methods.description: Attempts to pop a task from internal queues with retries.

methods.name: jobs_in_queue
methods.description: Extracts the number of jobs in queue from the state variable.

methods.name: active_forks
methods.description: Extracts the number of active forks from the state variable.

methods.name: job_enqueued
methods.description: Updates state when a new job is enqueued, possibly creating a new fork.

methods.name: reserve_fork_task
methods.description: Reserves a task for a fork, updating state accordingly.
